claims.claim_summary: Introduces a self-improvement loop extracting solution ideas in hindsight from supplied solutions.
claims.claim_text_verbatim: We introduce a self-improvement loop for reasoning models based on the following observation: Even when the difficulty of a problem exceeds the model’s current solving abilities, an additionally supplied solution might enable the model to extract useful solution ideas in hindsight.

evidence_spans.source_text: We provide a formal specification of our method for a general problem setting, together with the optional refinement for verifiable problem domains.

Subsequently, we execute a loop that alternates between obtaining a batch SampleBatch(t) of pairs in X × Y, constructing training triples in X × Y × Z from these pairs in hindsight, and training the system on a dataset composed of these newly constructed triples and previously collected data.

claims.claim_summary: Provides formal method specifications and a Lean theorem prover instantiation without empirical evaluation.
claims.claim_text_verbatim: We give a formal specification of our method and a concrete instantiation for interactive theorem proving in the Lean theorem prover; empirical evaluation remains future work.

evidence_spans.source_text: Building on the key ideas introduced in Section 1, we now give a formal description of our method.

To instantiate our method in the special case of interactive theorem proving (see Section 3.1), we provide concrete realizations of the abstract concepts introduced in Section 4. We use Lean and the verifier-guided choice for ConstructTriple from Section 4.6, as summarized in Algorithm 2.
This version of the manuscript reports no empirical evaluation.

claims.claim_summary: Employs a shared backbone network with role-specific prompt templates across all components.
claims.claim_text_verbatim: All three components share a backbone network; for example, when their inputs and outputs can be represented as text, we may use a shared language model with role-specific prompt templates.

evidence_spans.source_text: All three components are implemented using a single underlying language model with shared parameters, and we distinguish between components using role-specific prompt templates.
All trainable parameters are shared; prompts distinguish components.
